items.headline: Modular ETRM Architectures Gaining Traction in Europe
items.summary: LEAD Consult's CEO told CTRMCenter that firms, especially in the DACH region and Nordics, are increasingly connecting specialist trading modules via middleware instead of relying on monolithic ETRM/CTRM systems, per CTRM Center.

items.headline: EU ETS Revision Could Reshape ETRM Requirements
items.summary: The European Commission's 17 July 2026 proposal to revise the EU ETS, expanding scope toward maritime, aviation and waste incineration, remains under negotiation and may prompt new ETRM carbon-tracking needs, per CTRM Center.

items.headline: Fintechs Push Deeper Into Bank Trade Finance Turf
items.summary: PYMNTS reports fintechs are challenging banks on letters of credit and working capital financing as tariffs and shifting shipping routes make trade financing harder to manage, with export credit agencies also expanding mandates.

items.headline: Iran-Oman Near Deal on Hormuz Shipping Corridor
items.summary: Iran and Oman announced progress this week toward a permanent navigational corridor for the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran claiming a revenue-sharing toll agreement, though transit volumes remain subdued per Kpler data cited by Yahoo Finance.
